# FoodLine.sg

> > Singapore's leading catering marketplace connecting customers with 500+ caterers, featuring buffet catering, tingkat delivery, halal options, and corporate solutions with satisfaction guarantees.

FoodLine.sg is a comprehensive catering platform serving Singapore with over 117,000 customer reviews, exclusive discounts, and guarantees including best price and 100% satisfaction policies. The platform specializes in buffet catering, tingkat delivery, corporate catering with credit terms, and seasonal offerings like Chinese New Year catering.

## Key Topics

- Singapore catering marketplace
- Buffet catering services
- Tingkat delivery
- Halal catering options
- Corporate catering solutions
- 100% satisfaction guarantee
- Best price guarantee
- Customer reviews and ratings
- Gebiz accredited caterers
- Chinese New Year catering
- Food delivery platform
- Catering quotations
- Credit terms for companies
- Refund policy
- Customer protection
